decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The roof light shall be installed to be flush with the existing roof slope and have a 'conservation style' with a central mullion.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Informative: This approval is only to the installation of the roof light in the front elevation of the house and does not authorise any other alterations or additions to the dwelling that may require planning permission.

Condition : 5 - The application for the installation of a roof light to the front elevation of the existing dwelling, as shown on drawing number 263/01, received 5 October 2005, is recommended for approval as by reason of its size, position and appearance, there would be no impact on the amenity of the neighbouring properties and the appearance and character of the existing building and Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area would be adequately maintained. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Installation of a roof light to front elevation to house (Gunnersbury Park Conservation area)
